work.description: Allocution CCLXII publishes Giovanni Soglia, patriarch of Constantinople, and Antonio Tosti, treasurer general, created in pectore in the consistory of 12 February of the previous year, and reserves another; the edition prints it after the December 1839 allocution; LF57578 → LF57597 across CCLXI’s provenance LF57581, CCLXI’s note 2 LF57582–57587 (not selected), own provenance LF57588, a mark LF57591 and running title LF57594; LF57659 → LF57665 across page number 393 LF57662; ends with the Trinitarian formula LF57673–57674. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is g2 ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI. at LF57510–57510; the source closing at LF57656–57674 reads: Auctoritate omnipotentis Dei, sanctorum apo- stolorum Petri et Pauli ac Nostra, declaramus S. R. E. presbyteros cardinales Ioannem Soglia patriarcham Constantinopolitanum; Antonium 393 Tosti thesaurarium generalem., Cum dispensa- tionibus, derogationibus et clausulis necessariis et opportunis. Alium autem cardinalem creamus et in pe- ctore reservamus arbitrio nostro quandocumque declarandum, In nomine Patris + et Filii + et Spiritus + Sancti. Amen, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
